decisions.decision: Publish the Composer package as dev-lancer/von-halsky-php-sdk.
Release SDK source code under the MIT license already present in LICENSE.
Describe the package as independent and not an official InPost product; formal trademark review remains pending.
Do not commit full official OpenAPI documents or official examples until redistribution rights are confirmed.
Use only official InPost materials and Stage evidence as behavioral sources; unofficial SDKs are excluded.
